items.title: Sebi working to delist companies with no economic activity: Chairman
items.description: There are a number of listed companies with no economic activity, Sebi chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said

items.title: Sebi extends digital accessibility compliance deadline to January 31
items.description: The requirements are part of Sebi's earlier circulars on mandatory compliance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the rules framed thereunder by all regulated entities
